plan.summary: DIR-090 adversarial forensic audit COMPLETE. VERDICT: the claim of 100 percent token and layout parity does NOT hold. At or near parity: sidebar, top bar, metric row, toolbar shells, resume grid, right rail chrome. P0-1 INVARIANT BREACH - FABRICATED METRICS IN THE LIVE DOM: CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx lines 278-301 render a HARDCODED Todays Insights list. Line 285 hardcodes 69 percent ATS ready and line 294 hardcodes 3 new jobs match your profile, both VERBATIM copies of the reference screenshot, while the REAL computed insights memo at lines 94-120 is used only for its length in an sr-only span at line 279. The live capture proves the contradiction on screen: the metric donut shows a real 82 percent while the rail asserts 69 percent. This breaks the DIR-090 invariant Zero fabricated metrics or hardcoded scores. GAP-2 LEGEND AND SERIES COLOURS: the reference legend has 4 series (Applied, Shortlisted, Interview, Offers) but analyticsLogic.js PROGRESS_SERIES has 3. Dropping Shortlisted is CORRECT because backend/routes/jobsData.js line 20 restricts the real enum to wishlist, applied, interview, offer, rejected so Shortlisted has no data lineage. However the colour mapping is INVERTED: interview maps to cuba-warning 7d5800 dark amber and offer maps to cuba-success 1a7f37 green, whereas the reference shows Interview green and Offers orange. GAP-3 DEAD TOOLBAR CONTROLS: DashboardHomepage.jsx lines 1229-1252 render the Sort button and the Grid/List toggle with NO onClick and NO state, with Grid hardcoded active, so the mandated Sort over Last Updated, ATS Score and Title and the mandated view toggle are non-functional shells. GAP-4 MATCH BADGES: the reference 92, 86 and 78 percent badges are deliberately absent and dir094 AC3 fails the build if they are ever hardcoded, so column 2 parity is capped at visual and structural level by the honesty invariant and 100 percent parity is UNACHIEVABLE by policy. GAP-5 RECENCY LABEL: the reference shows 2 days ago while the live render shows 2d ago (analyticsLogic.js line 111). GAP-6 HEADER MICRO-LAYOUT: the reference places the quote inline to the left of the CTA group while the live render stacks it above. EVIDENCE-INTEGRITY DEFECT THAT INVALIDATES AC2: current_dashboard_bottom_analytics.png is BYTE-IDENTICAL to current_dashboard_live_1920.png, both 427882 bytes with MD5 734B5FC719CA5A4045F2B30F1E564C1E, because the scroll step at capture_dashboard.mjs lines 307-317 no-opped, so no valid below-the-fold artifact exists and only current_dashboard_tall_1300.png with MD5 8AEAD420346492EE5284D781ADC2EDA51 is genuinely different. The harness also mocks every API through page.route so its numbers are harness-fabricated, and it boots an in-process Vite server on port 5188 at line 26, violating the P0 XAMPP-only server invariant. GREEN GATES VERIFIED: dir084 8/8, dir085 6/6, dir086 6/6, dir090 5/5, dir091 6/6, dir092 6/6, dir093 7/7, dir094 8/8, frozen src/cv-templates git diff 0. The suites are green because none of them assert rail data lineage or toolbar interactivity, which is the test blind spot this audit exposes.
